dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a slight concave curvature with a spline deviation oriented toward the posterior caudal region.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute apex classification with a minimal pixel radius resulting in a sharp, non-rounded point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55 degrees relative to the dorsal ridge line of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The fin's maximum base width is approximately 1.2 times its maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Low-profile melon arc with a wide radius of curvature, exhibiting a flattened structural convexity.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick rostrum with a low length-to-thickness ratio as measured from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse inflection point of approximately 160 degrees where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible high-contrast white pixel grouping at the terminal tip of the rostrum and a secondary light-colored region in the periorbital area.
